title: Bounds on relative modular Hamiltonians in general QFT
summary: The relative entropy between two states is a key concept in quantum information theory and quantum field theory. In the setting of quantum field theory, its computation requires the handling of relative modular Hamiltonians, which are typically very difficult to compute explicitly. In this paper, we exploit locality properties of general algebraic QFTs to estimate relative modular Hamiltonians between two states, $ω$ and $\tildeω$, and hence also their relative entropy, in terms of the modular Hamiltonian of a reference state $\hatω$, which might be better understood.
